description: Takes stretches out of the video by film seconds or by word numbers, and closes the gap (everything after moves earlier). A cut never splits a word. Read again before the next change. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since.

operation_id.description: A retry with the same id runs once.

output_id.description: An output (Short, hook, shape); the main video when left out.

ranges.description: Film seconds to take out, [[from, to], ...] on the version you read.

words.description: [first, last] word numbers from get_transcript to take out.

name: cut

outputSchema.description: Clypmint cut result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Cut time out
